SELECT A.CONT_ID AS contId , A.SALES_ID AS salesId , A.CONT_NM AS contNm , A.CONT_AMT AS contAmt , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.CONT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS contDt , A.EMP_ID AS picUserId , B.EMP_NM AS picUserNm , A.CONT_STATUS AS contStatus , A.CUST_ID AS custId , C.CUST_NM as custNm , IF(F.FAV_ID IS NOT NULL, 'Y', 'N') AS favYn FROM TB_CONTRACT A LEFT JOIN TB_SALES S ON A.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER C ON COALESCE(A.CUST_ID, S.CUST_ID) = C.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP B ON A.EMP_ID = B.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_FAVORITE F ON A.CONT_ID = F.TARGET_ID AND F.TARGET_TYPE = 'CONTRACT' AND F.EMP_ID = #{loginId} WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND F.FAV_ID IS NOT NULL
AND A.CONT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY favYn DESC, A.CONT_ID DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CONTRACT WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND CONT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT A.CONT_ID AS contId , A.SALES_ID AS salesId , A.CUST_ID AS custId , A.CONT_NM AS contNm , A.CONT_AMT AS contAmt , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.CONT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS contDt , A.EMP_ID AS picUserId , A.CONT_STATUS AS contStatus , A.CONT_REMARK AS contRemark , A.ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId , B.SALES_TITLE AS salesTitle , B.EMP_ID AS salesUserId , C.EMP_NM AS picUserNm , D.EMP_NM AS salesUserNm , E.CUST_NM AS custNm , E.CEO_NM AS ceoNm FROM TB_CONTRACT A LEFT JOIN TB_SALES B ON A.SALES_ID = B.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP C ON A.EMP_ID = C.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP D ON B.EMP_ID = D.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER E ON COALESCE(A.CUST_ID, B.CUST_ID) = E.CUST_ID WHERE CONT_ID = #{contId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT S.SALES_ID AS salesId , S.SALES_TITLE AS salesTitle , C.CUST_NM AS custNm , S.CUST_ID AS custId FROM TB_SALES S JOIN TB_CUSTOMER C ON S.CUST_ID = C.CUST_ID WHERE S.STATUS = '영업완료' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CONTRACT CON WHERE CON.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND CON.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY S.SALES_ID DESC
